messages.author: 07082c2b48d8d18a
messages.subject: Remove authorization requirement
parts:
Is there a way to make an app freely accessible again once you have added an authorized user?

I've created an app. Then added an authorized user, e.g.

    addAuthorizedUser("garrett")
    deployApp()

The app then becomes password protected, as advertised in the Getting Started Guide. And my password works. Hooray! Next, I remove the authorized user. 

    removeAuthorizedUser("garrett")
    deployApp()

This user's password no longer works. Hooray, again! But the app is still password protected and now no one is authorized to access it. 

    authorizedUsers()
    ##    user  hash
    ## 1 FALSE FALSE

Is there a way to make the app accessible to _everyone_ once more?

Thanks,
Garrett

messages.author: 07082c2b48d8d18a
messages.subject: Re: Remove authorization requirement
parts:
Just for reference, I was able to make the app accessible to everyone again by deleting the password.txt file in the directory's shinyapps folder and then redeploying. 

Perhaps removeAuthorizedUser could automatically check if it is removing the last authorized user and delete password.txt, if so.

Garrett
